question: What fruit accrues to one who recites the twenty-seven-syllable Mahātripurasundarī vidyā?
inference: Reciting this vidyā yields worldly enjoyment and heavenly ascent.
uncertainties: Exact referent of vidyā comes from preceding context.
Surālaya may mean heaven or divine abode.
plain_english: Having recited it, he enjoys all women and goes to the abode of the gods.
